paper.title_en: Wave optical imaging of an oscillating electric dipole orbiting a black hole
paper.abstract_en: We study the electromagnetic radiation and wave-optical imaging of an oscillating electric dipole orbiting a Kerr black hole. We derive the effective 4-current associated with a pointlike oscillating electric dipole in curved spacetime, and use black hole perturbation theory to compute the resulting radiation field at future null infinity, from first principles. We then develop a wave-optical imaging framework for a moving electromagnetic source in curved spacetime. We obtain images of an orbiting electric dipole, displaying relativistic beaming, gravitational lensing, and Einstein rings. We study polarization-dependent scattering by comparing the images produced by spinning dipoles with opposite helicities, finding a displacement that roughly decreases with the inverse of the radiation frequency, as expected for a beyond-geometric-optics effect. Our results provide a first-principles benchmark for beyond-geometric-optics descriptions of electromagnetic radiation in Kerr spacetime.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文从第一性原理出发，基于黑洞微扰理论推导弯曲时空中振荡电偶极子的有效4-电流，并发展波光学成像框架，研究Kerr黑洞轨道电偶极子的辐射与成像，涉及相对论性束流、引力透镜、爱因斯坦环及偏振相关散射等超出几何光学效应的现象，与广义相对论基础紧密相关，理论深度较高，具有清晰的物理动机和可能的方法论贡献。
decision.title_zh: 轨道绕黑洞运动的振荡电偶极子的波动光学成像
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了绕Kerr黑洞运动的振荡电偶极子的电磁辐射和波动光学成像。我们推导了弯曲时空中点状振荡电偶极子的有效4-电流，并使用黑洞微扰理论，从第一性原理出发计算了在未来零无穷远处的辐射场。然后，我们发展了一个用于弯曲时空中运动电磁源的波动光学成像框架。我们获得了轨道电偶极子的图像，展示了相对论性束流、引力透镜和爱因斯坦环。我们通过比较具有相反螺旋度的旋转偶极子产生的图像来研究偏振相关散射，发现了一个随辐射频率倒数大致减小的位移，正如超出几何光学效应所预期的那样。我们的结果为Kerr时空中电磁辐射的超出几何光学描述提供了第一性原理基准。
